text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The night after wrapping up training with 
Mejiro McQueen. As I was working alone—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Good evening! Pardon me for intruding!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for dropping by out of nowhere 
at this hour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"My, you must be surprised. Allow me to 
explain the circumstances."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I listen to what the three suddenly 
appearing girls have to say. Apparently, 
they wanted to watch a movie, but the dorm 
TV broke downâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they asked if they could watch 
it in the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the short notice, but if 
you'd like, would you care to join us, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wonderful. Then I shall make the 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the four of us decided to watch a 
movie—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on! Just when I thought we 
escaped the monster, now we're locked in a 
room...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gah, completely boxed in on all sides……! 
At this rate, it's game over!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"This looks bad! We need to get out of 
this enclosed room and evacuate to 
safety!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I think so to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...No, wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, think carefully. This is a 
locked room. With only the two of them: 
the hero and the heroine."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Which means... this is our chance!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then you have to seize that chance! Stay 
right here—until that moment comes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely not! That's totally 
dangerous! We should definitely run away, 
right, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, me? Um... What do you think, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
You should hold your position and make the 
most of your chance

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is so, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, just as you say, I believe I must 
also lead from the front.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looking good, McQueen! You've got real 
guts as a front-runner!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
On another note... what about front-runner 
strategies?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
An open stance after all? Or maybe a 
closed stance focusing on the backswing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No way... How am I supposed to understand 
when you mix in all that golf 
terminology~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro McQueen was left 
overwhelmed for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, Trainer... I shall agree 
with Ryan as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then hey, McQueen, what do you think 
happens from here... Heheh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Could it be some kind of suspension bridge 
effect, maybe?! Like, realizing how much 
they mean to each other... or somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because—it's a locked room after all!! 
There's definitely something going on, 
right!? Right...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No way... How am I supposed to know when 
you lean in and ask so aggressively~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro McQueen was left 
overwhelmed for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, as the story neared its end—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Noooooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The monsters are piling on top of each 
other...!! Aah... they're looking this 
way!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's a disaster! Rescue, rescue! Mejiro 
Defense Force, mobilize!! Please hurry and 
defeat this monster~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm just glad you seem to be having 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well... as grand as the Mejiro family is, 
even we don't have our own defense force.
